abbreviation._instruction: Enter the official abbreviation of this common coordinate framework.

digitalIdentifier._instruction: Add the globally unique and persistent digital identifier of this research product. Note that this digital identifier will be used to reference all attached research product versions.

ontologyIdentifier._instruction: Enter the internationalized resource identifiers (IRIs) to the related ontological terms matching this common coordinate framework.

usedTaxon._instruction: Add the taxon (e.g., species) that was used for the creation of this common coordinate framework.
